title: Log Stream Packet Serializer
description:
Design a data transmission protocol that packs an ordered list of string messages into a single string stream payload, and later unpacks that payload back into the exact original list of string messages. Implement two operations:
- encode(msgs): Serializes a list of strings into a single string.
- decode(s): Deserializes the single string payload back into the original array of strings.
constraints: msgs[i] can contain any valid ASCII or UTF-8 characters.
input_format: For encode: an array of strings msgs. For decode: a single serialized string s.
output_format: encode returns a string. decode returns an array of strings.

examples.explanation: Encoding ["hello", "world"] produces a single payload string which, when decoded, yields ["hello", "world"].
The serialization algorithm correctly preserves empty strings and strings containing arbitrary delimiter characters.
An empty list of messages produces a valid payload that decodes back into an empty array.
